title: AutoInfo Knowledge Digest (agent-native JSON-LD)
description: Agent-native JSON-LD payload emitted by generate_digest and generate_report with format="agent" (renderer: _render_agent_json in src/autoinfo/output/__init__.py). @type: KnowledgeDigest. The schema is a LOCAL file under docs/schemas/ — the @context/@type identifiers are stable contract strings, not hosting URLs.

@context.description: Stable identifier for this payload kind. Must equal _JSONLD_DIGEST["@context"].

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Present on the full digest shape; absent on the empty-KB report variant.

domain.description: Source domain. Present on the full digest shape; absent on the empty-KB report variant.

period.description: Digest coverage period (e.g. week). May be empty string.

target_audience.description: Desired reader audience; null when not supplied.

title.description: Report variant only (empty-KB generate_report branch): human title.

summary.description: Report variant only (empty-KB generate_report branch): executive summary, empty for empty KB.

entries.description: Knowledge base entries surfaced in the digest.

trends.description: Trends synthesized by the LLM (from llm_synthesis.trends plus key_findings). Empty array on the empty-KB variant.

format.description: Report empty-KB variant only: the requested output format.

implications.description: Per-product analysis (spec §2.4, todo 7): one 'so-what' implication per key_findings entry, index-aligned 1:1. Optional — present only on product paths (premium-briefing / enterprise-briefing / magazine-digest) when the synthesis carries it; absent on default digest/report agent output.

risks.description: Per-product analysis: one risk object per key_findings entry, same order. Optional — product paths only.

action_required.description: Per-product analysis: one action per key_findings entry, index-aligned 1:1. Optional — product paths only.

key_metrics.description: Per-product analysis (enterprise-briefing only): quantified decision-support metrics. Optional — product paths only.

relevance_score.description: Raw relevance score; may be null.

confidence_score.description: relevance_score/100 rounded to 4dp; null when relevance is absent.

key_points.description: First ~3 sentences of the summary split on sentence boundaries.

entities.description: Entities derived from entry tags (name=tag, type=topic, relation=tagged).

direction.description: Empty string for plain-string trends; 'observed' for key_findings-derived trends.
